title: Trump admin permanently pulls funding from LA homeless agency over mounting fraud allegations
summary: The Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority will give up about $150 million in federal funding under a HUD settlement, with LA County managing the money.

title: White House blasts 'Trumpcare for All' pitch from far-left El-Sayed who called president 'unserious fool'
summary: White House slammed Abdul El-Sayed's "Trumpcare for All" pitch, warning the Medicare for All plan would threaten Americans' existing health coverage.

title: Europe assassination scheme emerges as Iran denies DC 'dirty bomb' plot amid Trump warning
summary: President Donald Trump warned Iran would pay a price like no other as Tehran's deputy foreign minister called the chemical weapons report a "shameful lie."

title: Judge fires back at Fani Willis' office in courtroom clash over Trump case: 'Due process doesn't apply to you'
summary: A Georgia appeals judge grilled Fani Willis' office over its bid to challenge nearly $17 million in legal-fee requests from Trump and other ex-defendants.

title: Warren grills Trump Navy secretary on cost of Iran war: 'You don't have any idea?'
summary: Elizabeth Warren pressed acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao on the Iran war blockade's cost as he dodged questions and urged funding to reach 355 ships.

title: Obama-appointed judge paves way to unseal Ilhan Omar search warrant in blow to Trump's DOJ
summary: A federal judge in Washington, D.C., paved the way to unseal the criminal search warrant and related documents against Rep. Ilhan Omar.

title: Mamdani takes swipe at Trump administration's response to tech outages: 'Far from what many wanted to hear'
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Tuesday blasted the federal government's response to multiple technical outages that impacted Americans.

title: Bush-appointed judge torpedoes Trump immigration rule, rips DHS for overstepping its authority
summary: A federal judge appointed by President George W. Bush ruled DHS overstepped its authority on the F-1 student visa, blocking fixed time limits.

title: ASRA NOMANI: Far-left US groups battle Trump plan to rival China's tech dominance
summary: The "Shut Down Pax" campaign, backed by CodePink and groups tied to Neville Roy Singham, fights President Donald Trump's bid to cut U.S. reliance on China.

title: Trump Treasury aims to slam shut banking loopholes that could enable fraud tied to illegal immigration
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the FinCEN proposal gives banks more flexibility to combat money laundering and terrorist financing risks.
